const fileUri = $('Upload Video Binary').item.json.file.uri;
const promptText = [
  "This is a fully assembled automated game review video, built by editing together several real trailer/gameplay clips with narration and captions. Watch the WHOLE thing carefully and evaluate it as a strict professional video editor doing final QC before publish would. Return structured JSON with EXACTLY these fields:",
  "{",
  "  \"issues\": [",
  "    {",
  "      \"timestamp_sec\": number (approximate),",
  "      \"category\": one of [\"sub_1s_cut\",\"rapid_cut_cluster\",\"jarring_internal_cut\",\"exact_repeated_moment\",\"near_duplicate_moment\",\"developer_publisher_logo_filler\",\"title_card_filler\",\"esrb_rating_card_filler\",\"platform_storefront_card_filler\",\"narration_visual_mismatch\",\"accessibility_narration_over_unrelated_footage\",\"excessive_trailer_pacing\",\"irrelevant_footage\",\"excessive_environment_reuse\",\"other\"],",
  "      \"severity\": one of [\"low\",\"medium\",\"high\"],",
  "      \"description\": \"one specific sentence describing exactly what is wrong at this moment\"",
  "    }",
  "  ],",
  "  \"overall_pacing_assessment\": \"one or two sentences\",",
  "  \"real_footage_confidence\": \"high\" | \"medium\" | \"low\",",
  "  \"would_pass_qc\": boolean (your own honest overall judgment -- but report every real issue you see regardless of what this ends up being; the caller applies its own stricter pass/fail rule on top of your issue list)",
  "}",
  "Category guidance -- read carefully, this channel has been burned by lenient QC before:",
  "- sub_1s_cut: a cut that is accidentally under about 1 second. This INCLUDES a tiny fragment at the very end of the video (e.g. a 0.1-0.3 second flash) that exists only to pad the timeline out to its exact target duration rather than because it serves the edit -- always flag that as sub_1s_cut, not as acceptable.",
  "- rapid_cut_cluster / excessive_trailer_pacing: three or more cuts within roughly a 2-second window, giving a rapid trailer-style flicker instead of a deliberate, watchable review edit.",
  "- exact_repeated_moment: the exact same footage moment (same source clip and timestamp) appears more than once in the video.",
  "- near_duplicate_moment: a visually very similar (but not identical) moment repeats -- flag it, but this category is inherently more subjective than exact_repeated_moment, so grade its severity honestly rather than always maxing it out.",
  "- developer_publisher_logo_filler / title_card_filler / esrb_rating_card_filler / platform_storefront_card_filler: ONLY flag these when the footage is NOT relevant to what the narration is actually discussing at that moment. A rating card shown while narration is genuinely discussing the ESRB rating, or a title card during an intro that discusses the game\u2019s title, is fine and must NOT be flagged. The same card appearing as random filler while narration discusses something unrelated (combat, story, performance, etc.) must be flagged -- this is exactly the kind of AI-generated-looking filler this channel does not want.",
  "- narration_visual_mismatch: the footage on screen does not match what the narration is describing at that moment.",
  "- accessibility_narration_over_unrelated_footage: narration about accessibility/settings/menu options plays over combat or unrelated gameplay footage instead of relevant menu footage.",
  "Severity guidance: use at least \"medium\" for developer_publisher_logo_filler, title_card_filler, sub_1s_cut, exact_repeated_moment, narration_visual_mismatch, accessibility_narration_over_unrelated_footage, rapid_cut_cluster and excessive_trailer_pacing whenever they genuinely occur -- these are inherently disruptive to a finished review, not cosmetic nitpicks. Reserve \"low\" for genuinely minor/arguable cases such as near_duplicate_moment or irrelevant_footage where reasonable editors could disagree.",
  "Be specific and concrete -- vague filler issues are not useful. Reply with ONLY the JSON object, no markdown fences, no extra text.",
].join('\n');
const request = { contents: [{ parts: [
  { file_data: { mime_type: 'video/mp4', file_uri: fileUri } },
  { text: promptText },
] }] };
return [{ json: { qc_request_json: JSON.stringify(request) } }];
